clips.caption:
Comment "WISH" and I'll send you Kevin's 14 Your Wish Is Your Command audios, free.

Kevin Trudeau says he got tired of working every day, so he sat down and wrote exactly what he wanted: no job, travel the world, and a minimum of $50,000 landing in his bank account every single week, with nothing required of him.

Friends asked him how he would pull it off. His answer: that's not your job. You define what you want, get in alignment with it, and let the universe work out the how.

Most people quit right there because they can't see the how yet.

What would you write down if the how wasn't something you had to solve first?

#kevintrudeau #yourwishisyourcommand #manifestation #lawofattraction #mindset #wealthmindset
clips.send: A friend stuck hating their 9-to-5 sends this to the friend who always says 'but how would I ever afford that': proof Kevin says the how isn't your job, the number and the belief are. Emotion: longing and hope.

clips.caption:
Comment "MONEY" and I'll send you Kevin Trudeau's Your Wish Is Your Command audios, free.

Kevin Trudeau says he had two unsolicited offers to turn his memory course into a TV infomercial, same week. He picked one and called Bobby Singer, the other guy, to decline. Years later, Bobby said missing it by one week cost him $30 million.

Making the infomercial took one day - no script, no teleprompter, just his usual presentation on camera.

Six weeks after it aired, the royalty checks started: $100,000 the first week, over $580,000 the biggest week. Total sales: over $450 million.

His own words for it: you get what you asked for.

#kevintrudeau #infomercial #passiveincome #wealthmindset #successstory #yourwishisyourcommand
clips.send: A friend building a side hustle sends this to the friend about to give up on it: proof that the payoff can dwarf the one decision that almost didn't happen. Emotion: awe, with a sting of anxiety about moving too slow.
